messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating action items for rollout/canary/feature-flag controls. I put proposed owners and dates. Please confirm or reassign.

matt: Thanks. Can we separate infra vs app flags? I can take infra-level guardrails.

jordan: I'll handle flagging ownership and telemetry for canaries. Adding a checklist.

anya: Checklist:
- infra: automated rollback circuit (owner: matt, due: 2026-04-02)
- app: stricter blast-radius defaults (owner: jordan, due: 2026-03-30)
- post-deploy sampling for canaries (owner: kevin, due: 2026-03-28)
- recurring incident pattern detection (owner: anya, due: 2026-04-06)
- runbook update + runbook drill (owner: matt, due: 2026-04-05)

kevin: For post-deploy sampling, propose 1% -> 5% ramp with health checks every 2m. I'll open PR.

jordan: Agree. Also propose feature flag default to "off" and explicit blast_radius param in flag API.

matt: For auto-rollback, infra plan: circuit triggers on latency spike OR error-rate > 1% for 5m. Fallback model mapping to smaller model variant.

anya: We also need ownership for the analytics alerts that detect repeat patterns (flag misconfig + burst traffic). I'll own it but need a data-eng review.

kevin: I'll stub the canary sampling config. PR link: https://git.redwood/s/2345

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature/auto-rollback -> canary at 2026-03-25T15:00Z

jordan: Quick note: add a preflight that validates flag scoping to avoid global-on by mistake. Suggest CLI check:
```
redwood flag validate --scope app:service --no-global
```

anya: Next steps: owners accept or reassign by EOD today; I'll collate into the incident action tracker and surface in next Monday ops sync. If no objections I will mark these as assigned.

kevin: Accepted (I'll own PR + test cases) :thumbsup:

matt: Accepted. I'll start design doc and link infra runbook.

jordan: Accepted, adding feature flag schema change to my backlog. ETA end of sprint.

anya: Thanks — I'll update the tracker and ping on Monday. /remind @everyone on 2026-03-29 to check progress.

sre-oncall: Noted. Will add a monitoring alert for flag scope changes.

anya: tagging action items in tracker: #INC-2026-23-ptf

matt: One more thing — automated rollback needs a safe mode: if rollback fails, flip to degraded fallback instead of global cutoff. Will include in proposal.

anya: Great. Closing thread for now, update the tracker when you have PRs or docs. :white_check_mark:
